source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第三节

textbook_summary: V1 R/S >= 1, V5 R/S <= 1, and aVR has a dominant positive deflection.
The frontal QRS axis deviates rightward to >= 90 degrees.
V1/V2 show ST depression and T-wave inversion.

authored_choices.construction: Reuses existing smooth Early/Main/Terminal basis functions. I/II targets are inverted to RA/LA/LL before projection; chest electrodes carry the Wilson reference. Q32 tables are generated offline with Fraction/ties-to-even arithmetic. These are not exact textbook case samples or actual ventricular contributions.

limitations: A single RVH example; severe qR, cor pulmonale and biventricular hypertrophy are not covered.
A fixed rightward axis, not a continuous independent-axis interface.
Mechanical events and perfusion are unchanged.
Windows visual behavior is not yet manually verified.
